item.description:
​

Genre: Progressive rock, Space rock, Progressive metal
Release date: 18th June, 2001​

This is the original CD, not the re-release that compromised the sound quality by making it louder. Later remaster also went the louder route, and sounds worse because of it. Not sure why a remaster was even necessary, since this album is very well mixed and holds up incredibly well.
